question: how a general electorate's previous party vote should move with the national change: proportional, same points, same log-odds, or between
eligibility: Stage5 backtest-records eligibility unchanged; the persistent-party composition of p, P0, P1 and the actual share is renormalised to sum one; no midpoint of source bounds

formulas.family: x=(p^theta+P1^theta-P0^theta)_+^(1/theta); theta=1 is A, theta->0 is P, theta=0.5 is H

arms.closure: q=x/sum(x); p=0 keeps x=0; clipping at zero only

metrics.M1: mean absolute error of (q_NAT - q_LAB) against actual, seats equal-weighted, with signed bias overall and by tercile of previous NAT-LAB margin
metrics.M2: macro-party MAE over persistent parties other than NAT and LAB with national share >= 1% in either election of the transition
metrics.M3: lead-call agreement and predicted minus actual count of seats with NAT ahead of LAB
metrics.M4: macro-party MAE, RMSE and vote-weighted MAE over all persistent parties
metrics.D1: large movers |ln(P1/P0)| >= ln(1.5), top quartile of the party's previous share: signed error and MAE
metrics.M5: Stage44 CLR residual (epsilon 1e-6) mean squared norm per category, per arm and transition, and ratio to arm P; reported, not in the rule

adoptionRule.beats: mean over the three primary transitions lower by at least the threshold and lower in at least two of the three transitions
adoptionRule.retainedSet: primary arms beaten by no other primary arm on M1 and on M2

classes.carry_mixture: retained set has two or more arms: equal-weight mixture with one arm per national draw shared by every seat
classes.mixed_report_to_james: retained set empty, or any comparison differs between the lower and upper 2017-2020 bounds

adoptionRule.materialityOverride: if across the four primary arms the 2026 count of general seats with NAT ahead of LAB differs by at most 2 and no seat's top party differs, record materially_invariant and stop refining
adoptionRule.qualifier: clear if the 90% paired bootstrap interval of the pooled M1 difference between the best member and the runner-up excludes zero, else weak

implementationBoundary: optional localParty.transform configuration key defaulting to the current proportional behaviour; live default, draw bank, export and TypeScript unchanged
doNot: candidate-vote ratio, minor-party spread or classification changes
geography fragmentation, Student-t, mixtures of noise, regimes, sigma shrinkage
change to the live configuration default, the draw bank, the export or the TypeScript

refitIfTransformChanges: Stage33/75 candidate means S, R, kappa (trained on Stage31 constructed proportional vectors)
local_party noise scales (residuals around the proportional constructed vectors)
recheckOnly: candidate balance scale and D107 multipliers (conditional on observed party vote; depend on S, R, kappa)
knockOn.followUp: conditional separate stage; not in Stage81
